nodes.label: my_user_config.h
nodes.desc: Compile-time feature matrix: #define USE_RULES (L577), #define USE_WEBSERVER (L536) decide which drivers even exist in the binary

nodes.label: setup()
nodes.desc: L420: loads settings, claims GPIOs from the module template, starts network, then hands over to loop()

nodes.label: loop() -> Scheduler()
nodes.desc: L893/L822: single cooperative loop that beats out timed slices (50/100/250 ms, 1 s) to all drivers

nodes.label: XdrvMailbox
nodes.desc: L201-214: one global struct (command, index, payload, data) handed to every driver call - the universal calling convention

nodes.label: ExecuteCommand()
nodes.desc: L339: every interface (MQTT, HTTP, serial, rules) funnels here; fills XdrvMailbox then routes

nodes.label: xdrv_func_ptr[] + kXdrvList
nodes.desc: L21/L548: compile-time table of up to 128 driver entry points, trimmed by #ifdef XDRV_NN

nodes.label: XdrvCall(function)
nodes.desc: L1156: broadcasts one function code to all drivers; stops at first claimant for result-carrying functions (L1220)

nodes.label: xdrv_01 .. xdrv_127
nodes.desc: 204 driver files: webserver, MQTT, rules, zigbee, lights, energy, sensors - each exposes one XdrvNN(function) switch

nodes.label: Xdrv02 MQTT
nodes.desc: Local-first client: MqttInit (L268), MqttPublish (L1138), cmnd/stat/tele prefix topics (L1167)

nodes.label: MqttPublishTeleState
nodes.desc: L944: TelePeriod counter (L1248) fires aggregated FUNC_JSON_APPEND telemetry as tele/STATE JSON

nodes.label: Xdrv10 Rules
nodes.desc: Rule engine: RulesProcessEvent (L880) matches triggers and re-enters ExecuteCommand with SRC_RULE (L839)

nodes.label: Xdrv01 WebServer
nodes.desc: TasmotaWebServer instance (L487/L666) serves the UI; ExecuteWebCommand (L590) re-enters the command path
